name: expiry_day_pattern_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY and BANKNIFTY expiry days, option market makers who are short gamma at near-ATM strikes must delta-hedge: they buy the index on dips and sell on rallies relative to the strike cluster with maximum open interest (a proxy for max pain). In the morning session (09:20-13:30 IST), this creates a consistent magnetic pull — when NIFTY deviates 25+ spot points below the max-OI strike, market makers absorb selling and create a floor, reverting spot toward the pin level within 30-90 seconds; the mirror image holds when price is 25+ points above. In the final 90 minutes (13:30-15:25 IST), gamma decays toward zero and market makers unwind their delta hedges en masse: the pinning force collapses, and any directional push creates a rapid 30-60 second momentum burst as de-hedging amplifies the initial move rather than dampening it.
core_signal_oneliner: Expiry day dual-phase: morning mean-reversion toward max-OI pin strike, afternoon breakout momentum from gamma-unwind de-hedging
